display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (Non-Supine): (Apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and with no oxygen desaturation used and with or without arousal) / hour of sleep in non-supine position from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in non-supine body position (>= 0% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hrop + hnrop + carop + canop + oarop + oanop + marop + manrop)/(remepop+nremepop)
